market_summary: Late New York trading has settled into low-volatility consolidation following heavy midday trend expansion across FX, metals, and equities. US100 and XAUUSD are both governed by positive dampening GEX regimes, which enforce dealer mean-reversion and stifle unconfirmed breakout attempts near major Put/Call walls. EURUSD, GBPUSD, and XAGUSD are pinned tightly near session lows with sub-1.0 RVOL and exhausted CVD slopes, while BTCUSD is firmly anchored at its session POC fair-value magnet. Across the board, lack of volume confirmation and mid-range or post-expansion chop dictate a disciplined HOLD posture on all instruments.
